response.justification: Bogdan has extensive experience in software engineering and leadership, with strong technical skills across multiple languages and systems. However, his resume lacks direct experience in AI/ML, cloud platforms, or entrepreneurial initiatives within AI strategy, which are critical for this role. His recent involvement with AI-agent infrastructure is promising but not yet sufficient to meet the director-level AI strategy requirements.
strengths: 15+ years of software engineering experience with diverse tech stacks
Strong leadership in open-source projects and mentorship (e.g., GISCollective, workshops)
Recent exposure to AI-agent infrastructure and developer tooling (MCP, frameworks)
concerns: No explicit AI/ML expertise or recognized expertise in AI with built products/platforms
Limited cloud platform strategy experience or entrepreneurial/AI-related roles in larger organizations
Master's/PhD in AI-related field is missing; education is in Computer Science and fine arts
